description: 0/0 at x=0 combining conjugate rationalization of a square-root numerator with the standard sinc limit sin x / x -> 1.

exercises.technique: 0/0 at x=0. Rationalize the numerator by multiplying by sqrt(2+x)+sqrt(2-x): (2+x)-(2-x)=2x, giving 2x/[sin x·(sqrt(2+x)+sqrt(2-x))]. Split off the sinc factor x/sin x → 1 and evaluate the remaining sqrt sum at x=0.
